name: CFX MoveUSD
oneLiner: MOVEUSD is CFX's Solana bank-deposit dollar token backed 1:1 by USD deposits in beneficiary accounts at FDIC-insured banks.
collateral: U.S. dollar deposits held 1:1 in beneficiary accounts at participating FDIC-insured banks for approved CFX customers.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption route for approved CFX customers, with MOVEUSD intended to settle one-to-one against bank deposits rather than a Treasury reserve portfolio.

applicabilityBasis.summary: MOVEUSD is a CFX-issued dollar token for payment and settlement flows, redeemable through designated channels for approved customers.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators; Metropolitan Capital Bank & Trust banking partner context
genius.notes: MOVEUSD public materials describe CFX issuance and designated redemption channels, but Pharos found no public GENIUS issuer intent, PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS issuer intent, token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for MOVEUSD.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: MoveUSD is issuer-managed on Solana and public docs describe a centralized CFX issuance and redemption process; available registry sources do not prove a holder-level freeze path.

reserves.name: USD deposits in beneficiary accounts at FDIC-insured banks

notices.title: Tokenized-deposit profile
notices.message: MoveUSD is tracked because DefiLlama reports a current price and circulating supply, but its public materials present it as a CFX-issued stable token for approved customers rather than an open DeFi-native stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: MOVEUSD is a tokenized bank deposit minted by CFX Labs (FinCEN MSB) when approved customers deposit USD into FDIC-insured partner banks; CFX retains full control of the SPL mint authority and cross-chain burn-and-mint, so supply creation is fully issuer-controlled.

controls.label: CFX Labs issuance backend (SPL mint authority)
controls.evidence: CFX Labs mints MOVEUSD when USD is deposited at partner FDIC-insured banks and controls the token contracts/mint authority on every chain via Wormhole NTT burn-and-mint; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

review.evidence: Public CFX/MoveUSD materials describe a centralized, fully-permissioned tokenized deposit: CFX Labs (registered MSB) mints against bank deposits and retains complete control over token contracts and mint authority across Solana/Base/Ethereum. SPL mint authority address not independently read.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer-controlled mint model is established from CFX materials and NTT coverage; the live Solana SPL mint/freeze authority address was not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Read the Solana mint account to confirm the mint authority and any freeze authority held by CFX.
